name: English - English Writing for Social Scientists C2
description:
This course is aimed at students currently writing in the social sciences (seminar papers, vignettes, theses). The sessions aim to introduce students to academic writing techniques with examples from the social sciences, introducing stylistic guidelines for forceful and clear English writing at a high academic level. Students will be expected to regularly provide examples of their own writing on which they receive targeted feedback from both the peers and instructor.

Although students from all departments are welcome, this course is designed specifically for students in the RESET and STS programs. Students from political science or education are also encouraged to join.
prerequisites: Ability to begin work at the upper C1 or C2 level of the GER. Basic understanding of grammatical terms (e.g., parts of speech, subject, verb, object, active, passive, nominalization).
